subject: Validation sprint commitments, owners, and weekly standup cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novatech.ai>, Natalie Park <natalie.park@intellifin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: validation sprint — proposed commitments and owners

Hi Sanjay / Natalie —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and the concrete commitments we discussed so we can align on the validation sprint: 

Summary of what we heard you need:
- End-to-end validation of the assistant in your claims triage workflow (latency under 350ms median, precision > 92% on top-1 classification for denial reasons).
- Data residency: inference to run in us-west region with logs retained for 90 days (per your compliance ask).
- Integration: a lightweight webhook + S3 log sink; no PII to leave your VPC.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Functional: model correctly classifies 85%-95% of historical queries in your seeded test set (you'll provide the dataset).
2) Latency: 95th percentile <= 500ms, median <= 350ms under validation load (5 qps baseline).
3) Business: 30% reduction in manual triage time on flagged claims within pilot scope.

Sprint timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, infra access, dataset transfer.
- Week 1: baseline runs + initial tuning; deliver validation_plan_v1.pdf (attached).
- Week 2: integration with webhook, test harness, run seeded tests.
- Week 3: final run, handover doc and recommendations, decision checkpoint (go/no-go).

Owners (internal / external):
- Infra access and setup: Natalie (Novatech)
- Data transfer and test set: Caroline (Novatech)
- Redwood implementation & tuning: Ben (me) + Rishi
- Stakeholder syncs and decision: Sanjay (Novatech)

Next steps / asks (actionable):
1) Sanjay / Caroline: confirm dataset delivery timeline and point of contact for S3 access (ideally by EOD Friday).
2) Natalie: confirm you can open the required firewall exceptions to our test IPs (I listed them in the Drive link).
3) Rishi / Lauren: Icc: will prepare the validation_plan_v1.pdf and a short SOW draft for review.

I attached a first-pass validation plan and SOW draft for your review (stubs below). If we can get the dataset and access this week we can start baseline runs Monday. Also propose a 30-min weekly standup Friday mornings PST to keep momentum — does 9:30am PT work for your team?

Attachments (stubs):
- validation_plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)
- sow-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 120KB)

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

---
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novatech.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Natalie Park <natalie.park@intellifin.com>
Cc: Caroline Kim <caroline.kim@novatech.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: validation sprint — proposed commitments and owners

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side and answers to your asks: 

- Dataset: Caroline will own the transfer; she'll stage a masked subset of 5k records in S3 by Monday 31 May. Caroline: CC'd — can you confirm the exact S3 path and whether you'll use a one-time presigned URL or cross-account role?
- Latency targets: the numbers look reasonable; one ask — can Redwood provide a P95 breakdown by model variant (we may need to cap token length at 512 for faster responses).
- Compliance: we need assurance logs will remain in our account; please share the proposed logging artifact names and retention config.

On the weekly standup: 9:30am PT Friday works for us.

Also looping in our security lead (Caroline) for the access and data transfer parts.

Sanjay Rao
Head of Product 
NovaTech AI
sanjay@novatech.ai

Subject: Re: Post-demo: validation sprint — proposed commitments and owners

Appreciate the quick reply, Sanjay. A couple notes / actions following Caroline's involvement: 

1) Data handoff: Caroline — presigned URL is fine for the initial 5k masked set. If you prefer a cross-account role we can support that as well; let us know and we'll share our minimal IAM policy.
2) P95 by variant: Rishi and I will run variant A/B (fp16 default vs int8 quant) and provide latency tables by token-length buckets (<=128, 129-512). We can also do an early run with a 256 token cap to set realistic expectations.
3) Logging: Lauren, looping you to confirm the log artifact names and retention. Lauren: can you confirm the artifact names we put in the Drive doc?

I've updated validation_plan_v1.pdf with a short section on token caps and run matrix (attached). If everyone is OK, we'll schedule the first baseline run for Monday 31 May at 10am PT.

--- Attachment stub: validation_plan_v1.pdf (updated) ---

Ben

Quick status and nudge before our Friday standup: 

- We have the minimal infra policy drafted and uploaded to the Drive link (see related_links). Lauren has confirmed the log artifact naming convention: novatech-validation-logs/{run-id}. Retention set to 90 days as requested.
- Caroline: still waiting on the presigned URL or role confirmation; without it we can't kick off the baseline run.
- Ben: I scheduled the first baseline job for Monday 31 May 10:00am PT — if access isn't available we'll move to Tuesday and notify the group.

Next immediate asks: Caroline to share S3 path or presigned link; Sanjay to confirm the seeded test set is the 5k masked records referenced. If we get both this afternoon we can keep Monday's run.

HubSpot: linked to deal RDW-2027-0419 (I created the record and added the engagement plan).

Thanks — see you on Friday 9:30am PT for the weekly sync.
